Want to bring ideas to life?   
 As an engineer you’re no doubt aware of Aurecon – we’ve been a leading design, engineering and advisory company for decades. But why should you choose to join us?   
 Every project Aurecon delivers leaves a legacy. Every project has sustainability embedded in decision making. And every project is at the leading-edge of technical eminence.  
 But it really comes down to one, crucial question: what kind of world do you want to create for the next generation? Truth is, the decisions being made right now will determine the future of everything – from the local community to the entire planet. One of those decisions is: who do you decide to work for?  

How your role will contribute to shaping what’s next   
 As a Structural Engineer, you'll be part of purposeful work that supports the future of the Built Environment. Collaborating with a diverse, multidisciplinary team, you’ll explore integrated solutions, offer thoughtful perspectives, and partner with clients to help them build a more sustainable world.  

What you’ll be doing: 
 Our Buildings Structures team are a highly motivated team, known for their highly technical and innovative approach to some of the most complex projects underway in the region. Some key aspects of your role will include:   
 Apply your experience in structural engineering to solve the problems of our clients using a design-led approach  
 Apply your thorough knowledge of applicable Australian Design Codes and structural engineering practices  
 Translate your design experience to delivering our projects on site with our construction partners.   
 Enjoy collaborating with colleagues nationally and internationally within Aurecon to solve our clients’ problems across multiple markets 

What are we looking for from you?   
 A relevant engineering degree and experience in Structural Engineering  
 A strong ability to shape thoughtful, effective technical solutions for the Building Structures we deliver  
 Excellent collaboration and communication skills with a wide range of people  
 Exposure to software such as Space Gass, RAPT, ETABS, RAM Concept, Strand7 and Revit  
 2+ years of experience in Building Structures engineering and design. 
 Australian Citizenship with the ability to obtain NV1 clearance if successful is preferrable.
